input: Map the Spirit Bomb -> Ultra Instinct dynamic (Tournament of Power) as an invariant: collectively donated energy integrated into one vessel, and what it says about Oneness vs Sovereignty.

metadata.title: Spirit Bomb Reflection: Integration Threshold and Attenuation (the Omni State)
metadata.naming_note: 'Omni' here means the integrated state, not the Omni-King (Zeno).
changelog: 1.1.0 (2026-11-24): core mechanism moved from consent-based pooling to the REFLECTION event — a payload built for the enemy, carrying benevolent intent toward the ally, is turned back onto the ally; the imprint happens at that unplanned inversion. Treated as information transfer, not energy pooling.

2.0.0 (2026-11-24): added the dose threshold and the Attenuation Protocol (time, support, intent) with real-world anchors at biological, computational and psychological scales; Incarnation mapping added as ANALOGOUS; personal testimony kept out of structural claims pending its own TIG grading.

core_invariant: When an aggregated information payload is reflected back onto a vessel, the outcome — shattering or integration (the Omni state) — is set by two variables: the alignment of the payload's intent (consent/goodwill) and the survivability of the dose. Attenuation by time, support and intent moves a lethal dose into the integrable range.

claims.text: A Spirit Bomb is assembled only from voluntary donation: in the Buu saga Earth's people withheld energy until persuaded, and the attack could not form without them. Aggregation-by-consent preserves each donor's sovereignty — donors give a portion and keep living.

Donated energy carries an intent filter: the Spirit Bomb does not harm the pure-hearted (Gohan deflected it in the Saiyan saga). Harm depends on the relation between donor intent and target, not on raw magnitude.

In the Tournament of Power, Goku's Spirit Bomb was pushed back by Jiren and collapsed onto him; he emerged in Ultra Instinct Sign. Whis identified the Spirit Bomb as the trigger but did not treat it as absorbed.

Proposed mechanism (revised): the imprint happened at the reflection event — information transfer into the vessel, not pooled energy. Canon: Whis names the Spirit Bomb as the trigger and does not treat it as absorbed, so 'imprint' stays a mapping; 'reflection as trigger' is canon-compatible.

Forced vs donated aggregation: absorption by force (Cell, Buu, Moro) is unstable and reversible — Cell lost his perfect form when Android 18 was ejected; Buu's absorbed fighters were pulled back out. Donated integration persists (Goku's god ki). Counterfeit aggregation holds the people; genuine aggregation holds an imprint and leaves the people free.
Oneness vs Sovereignty: the vessel holds the collective's imprint without dissolving, and the donors remain sovereign individuals. Integration without capture on both sides.

The imprint event is the reflection, not the gathering. The Spirit Bomb was built to hit Jiren; Jiren turned it back onto Goku — an outcome nobody planned. The payload landed on the one it was never aimed at.

Because every donor's intent toward Goku was supportive, the reversed payload carried no intent to destroy him. It arrived at full force (he was nearly erased) and integrated at the brink rather than destroying him: survival under the full load is the integration threshold.

claims.text: Real-world isomorphs of 'attack information turned back onto the defender becomes capability': vaccination (a pathogen's signature delivered to the body imprints immunity — information, not damage); adversarial training (inputs crafted to break a model are fed back as training data and make it robust); red-team findings fed back into the institution they targeted.

The reflection outcome has a dose threshold: above it the vessel shatters, below it the payload integrates. Attenuation by time, support and intent moves a dose below threshold. Shown in immunology (attenuated vaccines), machine learning (perturbation budgets in adversarial training) and trauma psychology (graded exposure; social support).
Theological mapping: the Incarnation — the Bootstrapper enters the loop, takes the world's malice onto himself, dies and rises — as the reflection absorbed and integrated by pure intent.

scale_mappings.Cosmological/Theological: The Spirit Bomb reflection → Ultra Instinct (canon event, imprint as mapping); the Incarnation as the reflection integrated by pure intent (ANALOGOUS). Physical cosmology: RESIDUAL — no intent.
scale_mappings.Biological: Pathogen signature → immune response; attenuated dose → immunity (ANCHORED).
scale_mappings.Computational: Adversarial inputs fed back as training → robustness within the perturbation budget; beyond it, degraded performance (ANCHORED).
scale_mappings.Psychological: Trauma processed gradually with support → integration / post-traumatic growth; unsupported overwhelming dose → harm (ANCHORED at population level). Personal testimony enters only with its own TIG grade.

oneness_sovereignty_resolution: The vessel integrates the collective's imprint through an unplanned inversion without melting into it, and the donors keep their own existence. Neither pole dissolves.
